messages:
marie: Quick heads-up — final patch queue for v1.6.0 is open. Cutoff in ~2h (16:00 UTC). If you have a hotfix, please put it in the `cherry-pick/rc-1.6` branch and ping me.

ryan: On it, I have one small logging fix. Will create a PR against `cherry-pick/rc-1.6` and mark as `release/needs-review`.

marie: Thanks. Reminder: commit message format must be `release: bump v1.6.0 — <short desc>` so changelog scripts pick it up. Also run `./scripts/changelog-lint` locally — CI will block if it fails.

anya: I can take changelog polish. Saw a couple lint warnings about scope names. Will submit a follow-up patch.

oliver: FYI there was a flaky test in infra-integration that caused a 2nd CI rerun. I'm rerunning the job now, ETA ~10m. If it fails again we should consider skipping the test for the RC.

marie: Good catch. If CI flakes again, add a comment with `@release-ops please skip-test` and include the failing job link. We'll make the call.

deploy-bot: [CI] infra-integration (job 4928) rerun started by oliver — https://ci.internal/jobs/4928 

ryan: CI passed on my PR. Submitted and requested review from @anya.

anya: Reviewing now. If changelog edits look good I'll merge and push the version bump.

marie: Planning an announcement in #announcements at 17:00 UTC once the RC is built and smoke-tested. If we need to slip, we'll post a short hold notice that says: "v1.6.0 announcement delayed — working on CI flaky test. ETA +1h".

oliver: Smoke tests are green on my staging run. All services responding.

marie: Awesome. Final to-dos before announce: 1) ensure version bump commit is present, 2) changelog entry cleaned, 3) release notes snippet copied to the announce message. If anyone expects a later PR that must land before announce, say so now.

ryan: Nothing else from me.

anya: Merged changelog polish, bumped version to `v1.6.0-rc1`. Pushed.

deploy-bot: [release-build] RC artifact v1.6.0-rc1 created — artifact/artifacts/1.6.0-rc1.tar.gz 

marie: OK — crafting announcement. Please use this copy (paste into #announcements) so we keep format consistent:

```
Heads-up from Eng: v1.6.0-rc1 is ready for rollout. Highlights: improved batching and cost-optimization heuristics, fixes to logging and API edge cases. Staged rollout begins at 17:30 UTC. If you see issues, ping @release-ops. Full notes: https://internal.docs/releases/1.6.0
```

marie: I'll post at 17:00 UTC if smoke tests finish OR at the time we agreed (17:30 UTC) for staged rollout. Tagging @release-ops to prep the incident channel in case of regressions. :thumbsup:

release-ops: Got it — we'll stand by. If you post a hold notice, we'll update the status page and pause downstream jobs.

marie: Thanks everyone — I'll post the announcement or the hold message depending on CI. Closing thread once posted. :rocket:
